str.slice(0,2).toUpperCase() : '??' const avatarColors = [['#2a1f05','#F5C518'],['#1a1f2e','#85b7eb'],['#1e2a1e','#5dcaa5'],['#2a1a1e','#d85a30'],['#221a2e','#d4537e']] const colorFor = (str) => avatarColors[(str||'').charCodeAt(0) % avatarColors.length] async function doSearch(val) { setSearch(val) if (!val.trim()) { setSearchResults([]); return } setSearching(true) const { data } = await supabase.from('clients').select('id, username, full_name').ilike('username', `%${val}%`).eq('status', 'active').limit(6) setSearchResults(data || []) setSearching(false) } async function submitRequest() { if (!reqForm.firstName || !selectedClient) return setSubmitting(true) try { await supabase.from('audit_log').insert({ event_type: 'access_request', client_id: selectedClient.id, meta: { first_name: reqForm.firstName, note: reqForm.note, client_username: selectedClient.username, requested_at: new Date().toISOString() } }) setSubmitted(true) } catch(e) { console.error(e) } setSubmitting(false) } async function submitSignup() { if (!signupForm.username || !signupForm.fullName) return setSubmitting(true) try { await supabase.from('clients').insert({ username: signupForm.username.toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g,''), full_name: signupForm.fullName, email: signupForm.email, phone: signupForm.phone, status: 'pending', submitted_by: 'public_form' }) setSubmitted(true) } catch(e) { console.error(e) } setSubmitting(false) } const neu = { card: '6px 6px 14px #12141c, -3px -3px 8px #2a2d3e' } if (submitted) return (
